state: **Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 2 in progress.** `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads* now covers everything a user sees: website pages, `about.md`, comments in published `.nvs` (including `website/snippets/`), `nvs` help text and diagnostic messages, and excludes the agent-only docs. Nothing of the site itself is built yet. The site today is Astro + Starlight with a Docs tree (rulebook, decisions, release notes, 325 Core pages, 314 of them drafts), a Why Novis page over 13 claims, and no example on the live site, because the mirror is gitignored and Pages never syncs it.
